words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: He is a member of the school club.
words.ex_cn: 他是学校俱乐部的成员。
words.en: A member is a person who belongs to a group such as a club, organization, or team.

words.ex: My aunt bought me a birthday gift.
words.ex_cn: 我姨给我买了一份生日礼物。
words.en: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.

words.tr: n. 祖母；外祖母；奶奶；外婆
words.ex: My grandma cooks soup every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我奶奶每个星期天都煮汤。
words.en: Your grandma is your grandmother. In other words, your grandma is your mother or father's mother.

words.ex: My grandpa grows vegetables in his garden.
words.ex_cn: 我的姥爷在他的花园里种蔬菜。
words.en: Your grandpa is your grandfather. You can call your grandpa 'Grandpa'.

words.tr: n. 叔父；伯父；舅父；姑父；姨父；
words.ex: My uncle works at a local bank.
words.ex_cn: 我的叔父在当地一家银行工作。
words.en: The brother of someone's father or mother, or the husband of someone's aunt.

words.ex: He took a photo of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的照片。
words.en: A photo is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.ex: I have a book.
words.en: To possess, own, or hold something.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr: art. 一个 （在下一单词为元音开头时代替“a”）
words.ex: I saw an apple on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我看到桌子上有一个苹果。
words.en: Used before a word that begins with a vowel sound.

words.ex: He is a handsome boy.
words.en: A handsome man is good-looking, usually in a way that is attractive to women. Something that is handsome is large in quantity or impressive in quality.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.tr:
n. 骑；乘坐；
v. 骑；乘坐；
words.ex: He gave me a ride on his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他让我骑了他的自行车。
words.en: To sit on and control the movement of an animal, especially a horse, or to travel in or on a vehicle or other conveyance.

words.ex: He rides his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去学校。
words.en: A bike is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet. You steer it by turning a bar that is connected to the front wheel.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.ex: The factory makes cars.
words.en: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make goods in large quantities.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: I took a taxi to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A taxi is a car driven by someone whose job is to take people where they want to go in return for money.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: He eats a lot of ice cream.
words.en: A large number or amount; a great deal.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr:
n. 种类；
adj. 善良的；和蔼的；
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you describe someone as kind, you mean that they are gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.en: The number 30.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: He has sixty apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有六十个苹果。
words.en: The number 60.

words.ex: He is seventy years old.
words.en: The number 70.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.en: The number 80.

words.ex: He is ninety years old.
words.en: the number 90

words.ex: There are a hundred students in the hall.
words.en: The number 100; the number that is equal to ten times ten.

words.ex: Let me help you with your homework.
words.en: To allow or permit something to happen or someone to do something.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.ex: The train leaves at five o'clock.
words.en: You use o'clock after numbers from one to twelve to say what time it is. For example, if you say that it is 9 o'clock, you mean that it is nine hours after midnight or nine hours after noon.

words.ex: I eat bread and eggs for breakfast.
words.en: The first meal of the day, usually eaten in the morning.

words.ex: We have dinner at 7 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上7点吃晚餐。
words.en: The main meal of the day, eaten in the evening or at midday.

words.ex: I eat lunch at noon every day.
words.en: A meal eaten in the middle of the day, typically one that is lighter or less formal than an evening meal.

words.tr: n. 就寝时间；睡觉时间；
words.ex: His bedtime is 9 p.m. every night.
words.ex_cn: 他的就寝时间是每天晚上9点。
words.en: The time when someone usually goes to bed.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: The boy is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男孩正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: A boy is a male child or a young male person.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.en: A cat is a small furry animal with a tail, whiskers, and sharp claws. Cats are often kept as pets.

words.ex: The girl is playing with her dog.
words.ex_cn: 这个女孩正在和她的狗玩。
words.en: A girl is a female child or young woman.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: He wears a black hat every day.
words.en: A hat is a head covering which is worn for various reasons, including protection against weather conditions, ceremonial reasons such as university graduation, religious reasons, safety, or as a fashion accessory.

words.ex: A bat flew out of the cave at night.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝙蝠在晚上从洞穴里飞了出来。
words.en: A bat is a piece of wood used to hit the ball in games such as cricket, baseball, and table tennis. It can also refer to a small animal that flies at night.

words.tr:
v. 跳；跳跃；
n. 跳；跳跃；
words.ex: The boy jump over the puddle.
words.en: To push oneself off a surface and into the air by using the muscles in one's legs and feet; to move quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: The boy kicked the ball into the net.
words.en: A ball is a round object that is used in games such as soccer, baseball, and basketball. It can also refer to a formal dance.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.tr:
n. 帽子；
v. 覆盖…的顶部；
words.ex: He wore a blue cap to the park.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶蓝色的帽子去公园。
words.en: A cap is a soft, flat hat with a peak at the front. Caps are usually worn by men and boys. A cap is also a protective lid or cover for a bottle, jar, or other container.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.ex: He bought a DVD of the new movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张新电影的数字化视频光盘。
words.en: A DVD is a disk similar to a compact disk on which a large amount of information, especially high-quality video, can be stored.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr: phrase. 练习本；作业本（用于书写练习或作业的本子）
words.ex: He writes his math problems in an exercise book.
words.ex_cn: 他把数学题写在练习本上。
words.en: A book with blank pages for students to write in, especially for doing schoolwork.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.ex: He bought a recorder to record his lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一台录音机来录课程。
words.en: A recorder is a device or a person that records something, especially sounds or events.

words.ex: He carries his schoolbag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天背着书包去学校。
words.en: A bag used by a student to carry books and other school supplies.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: She opened the window to let in fresh air.
words.ex_cn: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。
words.en: A window is a space in the wall of a building or in the side of a vehicle, which has glass in it so that light can pass through and people can see out.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.en: A blackboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk, used especially in classrooms.

words.ex: He sat on the chair and read a book.
words.en: A chair is a piece of furniture for one person to sit on, with a back and usually four legs.

words.ex: He does his homework at the desk.
words.en: A desk is a piece of furniture with a flat surface, typically used for writing, reading, or working on a computer.

words.ex: I looked up the word in a dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在词典里查了这个词。
words.en: A dictionary is a book in which the words of a language are listed alphabetically, together with their meanings, pronunciations, and other information.

words.ex: He closed the door quietly.
words.en: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

words.ex: He used an eraser to remove the pencil mark.
words.ex_cn: 他用橡皮擦掉了铅笔印。
words.en: An eraser is a piece of rubber or other material that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.ex: He put the books on the shelf.
words.en: A shelf is a flat piece of wood, metal, or glass which is attached to a wall or to the sides of a cupboard. Shelves are used for keeping things on.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.ex: The cat is under the table.
words.en: In or to a position below or beneath something.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: She put the apples in a bag.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果装进了一个袋子里。
words.en: A bag is a container made of flexible material with an opening at the top, used for carrying things.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.tr:
adj. 接近的；亲密的；
adv. 紧挨地；接近地；
v. 关闭；
words.ex: They are close friends.
words.en: To move so as to bar passage through something; to shut.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.ex: The students stand up when the teacher enters the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 当老师走进教室时，学生们站起来。
words.en: If you stand up, you rise to your feet from a sitting or lying position.

words.tr:
adj. 开放的；营业的；
v. 打开；开放；
n. 公开；户外；
words.ex: The park is open to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园对所有人开放。
words.en: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, you move it so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.ex: Please sit down and wait for the teacher.
words.en: To lower one's body into a seated position.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, feelings, or opinions.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.tr:
int. 请；
v. 使欢喜；取悦；
words.ex: Please pass me the salt.
words.en: to make someone happy or satisfied

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.ex: He is a big fan of soccer.
words.en: A fan is a device that creates a current of air by the movement of its blades. It is also used to refer to a person who has a strong interest in and admiration for a particular person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 一半；
adj. 一半的；
adv. 一半地；
words.ex: He ate half of the apple.
words.en: One of two equal parts into which something is or can be divided.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.tr:
n. 鱼；鱼肉；
v. 钓鱼；捕鱼；
words.ex: He caught a big fish in the river.
words.ex_cn: 他在河里钓到了一条大鱼。
words.en: A fish is a creature that lives in water and has a tail and fins. Fish is also the flesh of a fish eaten as food.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；

words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: He sleeps in his bedroom every night.
words.en: A bedroom is a room in a house or apartment where people sleep.

words.ex: He looks at the clock every hour.
words.en: A clock is an instrument that shows the time, usually in hours and minutes.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.tr:
n. 短袜；重击
v. 猛打
words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving for school.
words.en: A sock is a piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of cotton or wool.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: Wow, that cake looks delicious!
words.ex_cn: 哇，那个蛋糕看起来真美味！
words.en: You say 'wow' when you are very impressed, surprised, or pleased by something.

words.tr: pron. 这些；“this”的复数； adj. 这些的；
words.ex: These books are on the table.
words.en: You use these at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

words.ex: I see a bird in the tree.
words.en: to perceive with the eyes; to understand or comprehend something

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.ex: I have one apple.
words.en: One is used to refer to the first and lowest whole number, often used to indicate a single person or thing.

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.ex: He has a small dog.
words.en: If something is small, it is not large in size or amount.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: The ball is over there.
words.en: In or to that place; at a distance.

words.ex: He plays baseball every weekend.
words.en: a game played especially in North America by two teams of nine players, in which a player hits a ball with a bat and tries to run around four bases on a large field before the other team returns the ball

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；
words.ex: The sky has a blue colour.
words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: He drinks orange juice every morning.
words.en: The liquid obtained from or present in fruit or vegetables.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.ex: There are nine queens in the palace.
words.en: A queen is a woman who rules a country as its monarch or who is the wife of a king.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.ex: The rain fell all night.
words.en: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

words.ex: She combs her hair every morning.
words.en: Hair is the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans and animals, or the mass of such strands growing from the skin of a person's head.

words.ex: He gave a quick answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对问题给出了一个快速的回答。
words.en: Moving fast or doing something in a short time.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.tr:
n. 光；灯；光线；
adj. 轻的；浅的；少量的；明亮的；
v. 点燃；照亮；
words.ex: The light from the window brightened the room.
words.ex_cn: 窗户透进来的光让房间变亮了。
words.en: Light is the natural agent that stimulates sight and makes things visible. It is also used to describe something that is not heavy or a source of illumination.

words.ex: My father cooks breakfast every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我父亲每天早上做早餐。
words.en: A male parent of a child; a man who has begotten a child.

words.ex: My grandfather tells stories every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父每天晚上都讲故事。
words.en: The father of one's father or mother.

words.ex: My grandmother bakes cookies every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我祖母每个星期天都烤饼干。
words.en: Your grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.tr: n. 表兄弟（或姐妹）；堂兄弟（或姐妹）；
words.ex: My cousin plays soccer with me every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我的表兄弟每周六都和我一起踢足球。
words.en: A cousin is a child of your uncle or aunt.

words.ex: My daughter loves to read books.
words.en: A daughter is a female child in relation to her parents.

words.ex: My granddaughter loves to paint pictures.
words.en: A granddaughter is the daughter of your son or daughter.

words.ex: My grandfather loves his grandson very much.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父非常爱他的孙子。
words.en: A grandson is the son of your son or daughter.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.ex: He is a good son to his parents.
words.en: A son is a male child in relation to his parents.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: I saw him yesterday.
words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.tr:
n. 年龄；时代；
v. 变老；
words.ex: His age is 25 years.
words.en: The length of time that a person has lived or a thing has existed.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.tr: phrase. 与……相同的；和……一样的（用于比较两个事物在性质、特征或程度上一致）
words.ex: This shirt is the same size as mine.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫和我的尺寸相同。
words.en: Used to indicate that two or more things are similar or identical in some way.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；
adj. 近的；
adv. 近地；
words.ex: The cat is near the window.
words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: Mrs. Smith is our neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 史密斯夫人是我们的邻居。
words.en: Mrs. is used before the name of a married woman when you are speaking or referring to her. It is a title of respect.

words.tr: n. 祖父；祖母；外祖父；外祖母
words.ex: My grandparent lives in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖父住在一个小村庄里。
words.en: A grandparent is the parent of your father or mother.

words.tr:
v. 能；
n. 金属罐；
words.ex: I can swim very well.
words.en: Can is a modal verb. It is used with the base form of a verb. It is used to indicate that someone is able to do something or that something is possible.

words.tr:
n. 公园；园区；
v. 停放；停车；
words.ex: We walk our dog in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天早上在公园遛狗。
words.en: A park is a large area of land with grass and trees, usually in a town, where people go in order to relax and enjoy themselves. To park a vehicle means to leave it somewhere for a period of time.

words.tr:
adv. 很；相当；
adj. 漂亮的；
words.ex: The movie was pretty good.
words.en: If you describe someone, especially a girl, as pretty, you mean that they are attractive in a delicate way without being truly beautiful.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.ex: He is thin.
words.en: Having a small distance between opposite sides; not thick.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: He is a leader who helps his team succeed.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助团队取得成功的领袖。
words.en: A leader is the person in charge of a group, organization, or country, who makes decisions and ensures that things are done effectively.

words.ex: He plays basketball every weekend.
words.en: A game played between two teams of five players in which goals are scored by throwing a ball through a netted hoop fixed above each end of the court.

words.tr: int. <非正式>呀呣，表示好吃或好闻; 【名】 （Yum）（美）鑫（人名）
words.ex: Yum! This cake smells amazing.
words.ex_cn: 呀呣！这个蛋糕闻起来太棒了。
words.en: Used to express that something tastes or smells delicious.

words.ex: She completed a 675-hour training program.
words.ex_cn: 她完成了一个675小时的培训项目。
words.en: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He listens to pop music every day.
words.en: Pop music is a genre of popular music that originated in its modern form during the mid-1950s in the United States and the United Kingdom.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.ex: He uses a mobile phone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A mobile phone is a telephone that you can carry with you and use to make or receive calls wherever you are.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.ex: The box is heavy.
words.en: Something that is heavy weighs a lot.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.tr: abbr. 激光唱片；光盘；“Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: I bought a cd of my favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张我最爱歌曲的激光唱片。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cd) that is a soft, bluish-white metal, often used in batteries and pigments, and is toxic.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: I will borrow a book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我将从图书馆借一本书。
words.en: To take and use something that belongs to someone else with the intention of returning it.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.tr: phrase. 对不起；麻烦你；打扰一下
words.ex: Excuse me, I didn't mean to bump into you.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我不是故意撞到你的。
words.en: used as a polite way to get someone's attention, to interrupt someone, or to ask someone to move so that you can pass

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.tr:
conj. 在…的时候；
adv. 什么时候；
words.ex: I eat breakfast when I wake up.
words.en: You use when to ask about the time that something happened or will happen.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 第一的；
adv. 首先；第一；
n. 第一；
words.ex: He got the first prize in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第一名。
words.en: A fist is the hand with the fingers bent in towards the palm and held tightly there, typically in order to strike a blow or grasp something.

words.tr:
int. 对不起；抱歉；
adj. 抱歉的；遗憾的；
words.ex: Sorry, I broke your cup.
words.ex_cn: 对不起，我打碎了你的杯子。
words.en: feeling or expressing regret or sorrow or a sense of loss over something done or undone

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.ex: He joins a chess club after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部。
words.en: A club is an organization of people with a common purpose or interest, who meet regularly and take part in shared activities. It can also refer to a heavy stick used as a weapon or for hitting a ball in sports.

words.ex: He was born in July.
words.en: July is the seventh month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: He plays chess every evening.
words.en: Chess is a board game for two players, each beginning with 16 pieces of six kinds that are moved according to specific rules, the object being to checkmate the opponent's king.

words.tr:
n. 练习；实践；惯常做法；
v. 从事；练习；
words.ex: Daily practice helps you improve your skills.
words.ex_cn: 每天的练习帮助你提高技能。
words.en: Practice is the act of rehearsing a behavior over and over, or engaging in an activity again and again, for the purpose of improving or mastering it, as in the phrase 'practice makes perfect'.

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.ex: I went to the bathroom after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭后我去了一趟浴室。
words.en: A room containing a bath or shower and typically also a washbasin and a toilet.

words.ex: We eat dinner in the dining room.
words.en: A dining room is a room in a house where people eat their meals.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: We watch TV in the living room.
words.en: A room in a house for general and informal everyday use.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: He sits on the sofa every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都坐在沙发上。
words.en: A sofa is a long, comfortable seat with a back and usually with arms, which two or three people can sit on.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: The boy is flying a kite in the park.
words.en: A kite is a toy consisting of a light frame covered with paper, cloth, or plastic, which you fly in the air at the end of one or more long strings. It is also a bird of prey with long pointed wings and a forked tail.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: The plane landed safely at the airport.
words.en: A plane is a vehicle designed for air travel that has wings and one or more engines.

words.ex: He wears a white shirt to work.
words.ex_cn: 他穿一件白衬衫去上班。
words.en: A shirt is a piece of clothing for the upper body, typically having a collar, sleeves, and buttons down the front.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；
words.ex: The cat is behind the sofa.
words.en: If something is behind a thing or person, it is on the far side of them as they face you, or is in a back part of them.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.en: in or to all places

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.en: at the present time or moment

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.ex: The child drew a sun with a red crayon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用红色蜡笔画了一个太阳。
words.en: A crayon is a stick of colored wax used for drawing or coloring.

words.ex: He writes in his diary every night.
words.en: A diary is a book in which you write down your personal experiences and thoughts each day.

words.ex: The window is made of glass.
words.en: Glass is a hard, brittle substance, typically transparent or translucent, made by fusing sand with soda, lime, and sometimes other ingredients and cooling rapidly.

words.tr:
adj. 关键的；
n. 钥匙；关键；
words.ex: This is a key step to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决问题的关键步骤。
words.en: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

words.ex: She cut the paper with scissors.
words.en: Scissors are a tool used for cutting paper, cloth, hair, etc., consisting of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle so that the sharp edges slide against each other.

words.ex: He brushes his teeth with a toothbrush every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用牙刷刷牙。
words.en: A toothbrush is a small brush with a long handle that you use to clean your teeth.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This book is hers.
words.en: used to refer to something belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes.
words.en: used to describe two things that are the same or similar and are meant to be used together

words.ex: This book is ours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我们的人或物。
words.en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

words.ex: The books are theirs.
words.en: You use theirs to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He put the book on the table.
words.en: If you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: He walks in the forest every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在森林里散步。
words.en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

words.ex: The children played on the green hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在绿色的丘陵上玩耍。
words.en: A hill is a piece of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it, but not as high as a mountain.

words.ex: The children play by the lake.
words.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: The children play near the river.
words.en: A river is a large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: I buy milk and bread at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市买牛奶和面包。
words.en: A large self-service store selling foods and household goods.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: He goes fishing on weekends.
words.en: To go fishing means to spend time trying to catch fish, typically as a hobby or for relaxation.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.ex: There are lots of books on the shelf.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.ex: He speaks English as his first language.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语作为他的第一语言。
words.en: Language is the system of communication in speech and writing that is used by people of a particular country or area.

words.ex: I draw money from the bank every week.
words.en: To make a picture, pattern, or diagram by making lines and marks, especially with a pen or pencil, on paper.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr:
n. 油漆；绘画颜料；
v. 刷油漆；画；
words.ex: The paint on the wall is peeling.
words.en: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or to produce a picture.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: He plays volleyball every Saturday.
words.en: A game played by two teams of six players in which a large ball is hit by hand over a high net, the aim being to score points by making the ball reach the ground on the opponent's side of the court.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: Our team won the soccer match.
words.ex_cn: 我们的团队赢得了足球比赛。
words.en: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；令人厌倦的； v. “bore”的现在分词；
words.ex: The movie was boring.
words.en: If you describe something or someone as boring, you mean that they are not interesting and make you feel tired or impatient.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr:
v. 行动；表现；演戏；
n. 行动；法令；
words.ex: He acted quickly to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速行动救了那个孩子。
words.en: To do something for a particular purpose or in a particular way; to behave in a particular way; to have an effect or influence on something; to perform a part in a play, film, etc.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.tr:
adj. 法国的；法国人的；法语的；
n. 法语；法国人；
words.ex: She ate french bread for breakfast.
words.en: relating to France, its people, or its language

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: He watches the olympics every four years.
words.en: The Olympics are an international sports festival that originated in ancient Greece and includes summer and winter sports competitions in which thousands of athletes from around the world participate.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: He plays the guitar every day.
words.en: A guitar is a musical instrument with six strings that you play by plucking or strumming the strings.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.ex: He takes photos of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.tr:
n. 手臂；
v. 武装；
words.ex: He raised his arm to wave hello.
words.en: An arm is one of the two long parts of your body that are attached to your shoulders and that have your hands at the end.

words.ex: He hurt his leg while playing soccer.
words.en: A leg is one of the limbs on which a person or animal walks and stands.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.tr:
auxv. 必须；一定要；
n. 必须做的事；必不可少的事物；
words.ex: You must finish your homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is very likely or certain to be true or to happen.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: They help each other with homework.
words.en: You use each other when you are saying that each member of a group does something to or for the other members.

words.tr:
adj. 自己的；
v. 拥有；
words.ex: This is my own book.
words.en: If you own something, it belongs to you.

words.ex: The singer sang a beautiful song at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这位歌手在音乐会上唱了一首动听的歌。
words.en: A singer is a person who sings, especially as a profession.

words.ex: She moved to Australia last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.ex: He lives in Canada.
words.en: Canada is a country in North America consisting of ten provinces and three territories. Located in the northern part of the continent, it extends from the Atlantic Ocean in the east to the Pacific Ocean in the west and northward into the Arctic Ocean.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.ex: The United Kingdom has four countries.
words.en: The United Kingdom is a country in northwestern Europe, consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

words.tr: phrase. 英国（United Kingdom 的缩写）
words.ex: The UK has many old castles.
words.ex_cn: 英国有很多古老的城堡。
words.en: The United Kingdom, a country in northwestern Europe, consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

words.ex: The Amazon River is in America.
words.en: The term 'America' can refer to the United States of America or the continents of North America and South America collectively.

words.ex: He was born in England.
words.en: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Scotland to the north and Wales to the west; the Irish Sea is to the north west, the Celtic Sea to the south west, while the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south separate it from continental Europe.

words.tr: n. 多伦多（加拿大城市）
words.ex: He lives in Toronto.
words.en: Toronto is the capital city of the province of Ontario and the largest city in Canada by population.
